Logical Model: MII LM Patho Logical Model

Official URL: https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-patho/StructureDefinition/mii-lm-patho-logical-model Version: 2027.0.0-ballot.rc
Active as of 2026-09-01 Computable Name: MII_LM_Patho_Logical_Model

Logical Model for the graphical reprensentation of the respective Art-Decor Model

Usages:

  • This Logical Model is not used by any profiles in this Specification

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics

Bindings
Constraints
Obligations
mii-lm-patho-logical-model 0..* Base MII LM Patho Logical Model
Identifikation 1..* Identifier The identifier of a pathology report (e.g. E/20/12345.1) is unique and is usually derived from the accession number (case number). It should be composed of the set ID (e.g. E/20/12345), under which all versions of a report are recorded, and the version number (e.g. 1). It is, however, also possible to use a UID (unique identifier) or GUID (global unique identifier) that is not derived from the case number. Usually the case number is used as the set ID.
Status 1..1 code Status of the pathology report.
Dokumentationsdatum 1..1 dateTime Date and time at which the pathology report was documented (verified and released).
Untersuchungsauftrag 1..1 BackboneElement Examination request
@id 0..1 string Unique id for inter-element referencing
extension 0..* Extension Additional content defined by implementations
Slice: Unordered, Open by value:url
modifierExtension ?!Σ 0..* Extension Extensions that cannot be ignored even if unrecognized

modifierExtension ?!Σ 0..* Extension Extensions that cannot be ignored even if unrecognized
Fragestellung 0..1 string Clinical question for the case
Anamnese 0..* string History of present illness for the case
Ueberweisungsgrund 0..* string Reason for referral
DiagnoseKodiert 0..* Reference(Condition) Diagnosis according to the valid ICD-10-GM

AuftragsIDAuftragnehmer 0..1 Identifier Order ID assigned by the filler (pathology), often identical to the case number
Status 1..1 code Status of the pathology examination request
Untersuchung 0..* CodeableConcept Ordered examination in coded form
Einsender 0..* Reference(Practitioner | Organization) Doctor who sends specimens of a patient for pathological-anatomical examination and who is the recipient of the pathology report.

Identifikation 1..* Identifier The identifier of a pathology report (e.g. E/20/12345.1) is unique and is usually derived from the accession number (case number). It should be composed of the set ID (e.g. E/20/12345), under which all versions of a report are recorded, and the version number (e.g. 1).
